objective: Descubrir si existe un puente canonico reutilizable entre cliente y ticket/transaccion/venta para atribuir actividad comercial Customer360 sin joins inventados. Solo SQL READ_ONLY; no modificar vistas, tablas, codigo ni Produccion.

queries.name: g4e_r4_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS user_name

queries.name: g4e_r4_cliente_ticket_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(c.name)='clienteid') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND (LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%ticket%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%transaccion%' OR LOWER(c.name)='ventaid' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%folio%')) ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: g4e_r4_cliente_sourcekey_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(c.name)='clienteid') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(c.name) IN ('sourcekey','referenciaexterna','uuidfactura','numerofactura')) ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: g4e_r4_ticket_key_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%ticket%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%transaccion%' OR LOWER(c.name)='ventaid' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%folio%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_r4_rrr_eventos_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.RRR_Eventos') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_r4_candidate_bridge_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns x WHERE x.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(x.name)='clienteid') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns y WHERE y.object_id=o.object_id AND (LOWER(y.name) LIKE '%ticket%' OR LOWER(y.name) LIKE '%transaccion%' OR LOWER(y.name)='ventaid' OR LOWER(y.name) LIKE '%folio%' OR LOWER(y.name) IN ('sourcekey','referenciaexterna','uuidfactura','numerofactura'))) ORDER BY s.name,o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: g4e_r4_candidate_bridge_rowcounts
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS object_name,ISNULL(p.rows,0) AS approx_rows FROM sys.objects o LEFT JOIN (SELECT object_id,SUM(rows) AS rows FROM sys.partitions WHERE index_id IN (0,1) GROUP BY object_id) p ON p.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.type='U' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns x WHERE x.object_id=o.object_id AND LOWER(x.name)='clienteid') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.columns y WHERE y.object_id=o.object_id AND (LOWER(y.name) LIKE '%ticket%' OR LOWER(y.name) LIKE '%transaccion%' OR LOWER(y.name)='ventaid' OR LOWER(y.name) LIKE '%folio%' OR LOWER(y.name) IN ('sourcekey','referenciaexterna','uuidfactura','numerofactura'))) ORDER BY o.name
